readOnly: The server's settings file is newer than this Reframe or cannot be read, so changes would not be saved. The settings are shown read-only.

tools.title: Tools
tools.intro: The programs Reframe runs. Where each one comes from: an environment variable on the server, a path in the settings, the bundled build, or the system PATH.
tools.bundledUseless: Environment variables on the server set ffmpeg and ffprobe, so a bundled FFmpeg would not be used.
tools.envNote: The environment variable {variable} on the server sets this path. To change it, change or unset the variable there and restart the server.
tools.webNote: A browser cannot choose the programs the server runs. Set {variable} on the server, or the path in the server's settings file.

encoders.title: Encoders
encoders.neverChecked: The encoders have not been checked yet.
encoders.fromCache: The statuses come from the cache and have not been checked again yet.
encoders.hardwareTestsHelp: Encode a few frames with each hardware encoder to find out whether it works. Off: hardware encoders stay "not tested".
encoders.vaapiHelp: Automatic tests the VAAPI encoders on every render node and uses the first one where each works. Choose a node to force it, for example on a computer with two GPUs.
encoders.tableCaption: Every encoder Reframe knows, with its status

output.title: Output
output.collisionHelp: Ask: the job stops and asks. Auto-rename: adds a number to the name. Overwrite: replaces the file.
output.partialHelp: What happens to the unfinished output file when a job fails or is cancelled.

queue.title: Queue
queue.parallelHelp: How many jobs encode at the same time.
queue.whenDoneHelpWeb: Sleep and Shut down act on the server's computer, after a countdown that can be cancelled.
queue.whenDoneHelpDesktop: Quit, Sleep and Shut down start after a countdown that can be cancelled.
queue.sleepInhibitHelp: Stops automatic sleep while jobs run. Your own Sleep, the power button and the lid still work.
queue.notificationsHelp: A notification when a job is done or fails.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.languageHelp: The language of the user interface.
